chapterInfo.content:
12
Onyansafoɔ ne ɔkwasea su
1 # Mmb 13.1, 18 Deɛ ɔdɔ atenetene dɔ nimdeɛ,
na deɛ ɔtane animka di mmoasɛm.
2Onipa pa nya AWURADE anim anisɔ,
na onipa busuyɛfoɔ deɛ, ɔbu no fɔ.
3 # Mmb 12.12 Onipa remfa abɔnefosɛm so ntim,
na ateneneefoɔ nhini rempusu.
4 # Mmb 31.10-31 Ɔyepa yɛ ne kunu abotire,
na deɛ ɔka aniwusɛm te sɛ nnompe mu porɔ.
5 # 1 Ah 12.6-19 Teneneeni adwene tene,
na abɔnefoɔ agyinatuo deɛ ɛyɛ nkontompo.
6Abɔnefoɔ nsɛm yɛ mogyatɛ,
na teefoɔ ano bɛyi wɔn.
7 # Mmb 10.25; Hiob 8.13-19 Wɔbutu abɔnefoɔ, na wɔnni hɔ,
na ateneneefoɔ fie deɛ ɛbɛgyina.
8Onipa nimdeɛ so na wɔyi no ayɛ,
na deɛ wakyea n’akoma no anim bɛgu ase.
9Deɛ wɔmmu no nanso ɔwɔ akoa no yɛ
sene deɛ ɔhyehyɛ ne ho na n’aduane bɔ no.
10 # Eks 23.5 Ɔteneneeni bu n’afieboa kra,
na abɔnefoɔ ayamyɛ yɛ atirimuɔden.
11 # Mmb 28.19 Deɛ ɔdɔ n’asase no didi mee,
na deɛ ɔdi nsɛnhunu akyire nni ti.
12 # Mmb 12.3 Ɔbɔnefoɔ pɛ deɛ nnipa bɔne anya,
na ateneneefoɔ nhini bɛso aba.
13Ano mfomsoɔ yɛ fidie ma ɔbɔnefoɔ,
na ɔteneneeni bɛfiri ahohiahia mu.
14 # Rom 2.6 Onipa anomu aba na ɔde bɛdi papa ameeɛ,
na onipa nsa ano adeɛ na wɔbɛdane ama no.
15Ogyimifoɔ kwan tene n’ani so,
na deɛ ɔtie afotuo yɛ onyansafoɔ.
16Ogyimifoɔ abohuro da adi ntɛm,
na ɔbadwemma deɛ, ɔkata aniwuo so.
17Deɛ ɔka nokorɛ no ka deɛ ɛtene,
na ɔdansekurumfoɔ deɛ, ɔtwa nkontompo.
18 # Mmb 13.3 Ɛwɔ deɛ ɔworo kasa sɛ nkrantɛ nwowɔeɛ,
na onyansafoɔ tɛkyerɛma sa yadeɛ.
19Nokorɛ ano tim hɔ daa,
na tɛkyerɛma torofoɔ deɛ wɔnkyɛre koraa.
20Nnaadaa wɔ wɔn a wɔdwene bɔne akoma mu,
na asomdwoeɛ ho afotufoɔ nya anigyeɛ.
21Mmusuo biara rento ɔteneneeni,
na amaneɛ bɛhyɛ abɔnefoɔ ma.
22 # Mmb 6.17 AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne atorɔ ano,
na wɔn a wɔdi nokorɛ sɔ n’ani.
23 # Mmb 29.11 Onipa niteɛfoɔ kora nimdeɛ,
na nkwaseafoɔ akoma pae agyimisɛm mu.
24 # Mmb 10.4 Nsiyɛfoɔ nsa bɛdi panin,
na aniha nsa bɛyi toɔ.
25 # Mmb 16.24 Onipa akoma mu awerɛhoɔ boto no,
na asɛmpa ma akoma tɔ yam.
26Ɔteneneeni kyerɛ ne yɔnko kwan,
na abɔnefoɔ kwan ma wɔfom.
27 # Mmb 12.24 Onihafoɔ nsa nka ne hanam,
na nsiyɛfoɔ deɛ ɔnya onipa adeɛ a ne boɔ yɛ den.
28Tenenee kwan so na nkwa wɔ,
na kwatikwan deɛ, ɛkɔ owuo mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Deɛ ɔdɔ atenetene dɔ nimdeɛ,
na deɛ ɔtane animka di mmoasɛm.
Onipa pa nya AWURADE anim anisɔ,
na onipa busuyɛfoɔ deɛ, ɔbu no fɔ.
Onipa remfa abɔnefosɛm so ntim,
na ateneneefoɔ nhini rempusu.
Ɔyepa yɛ ne kunu abotire,
na deɛ ɔka aniwusɛm te sɛ nnompe mu porɔ.
Teneneeni adwene tene,
na abɔnefoɔ agyinatuo deɛ ɛyɛ nkontompo.
Abɔnefoɔ nsɛm yɛ mogyatɛ,
na teefoɔ ano bɛyi wɔn.
Wɔbutu abɔnefoɔ, na wɔnni hɔ,
na ateneneefoɔ fie deɛ ɛbɛgyina.
Onipa nimdeɛ so na wɔyi no ayɛ,
na deɛ wakyea n’akoma no anim bɛgu ase.
Deɛ wɔmmu no nanso ɔwɔ akoa no yɛ
sene deɛ ɔhyehyɛ ne ho na n’aduane bɔ no.
Ɔteneneeni bu n’afieboa kra,
na abɔnefoɔ ayamyɛ yɛ atirimuɔden.
Deɛ ɔdɔ n’asase no didi mee,
na deɛ ɔdi nsɛnhunu akyire nni ti.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ pɛ deɛ nnipa bɔne anya,
na ateneneefoɔ nhini bɛso aba.
Ano mfomsoɔ yɛ fidie ma ɔbɔnefoɔ,
na ɔteneneeni bɛfiri ahohiahia mu.
Onipa anomu aba na ɔde bɛdi papa ameeɛ,
na onipa nsa ano adeɛ na wɔbɛdane ama no.
Ogyimifoɔ kwan tene n’ani so,
na deɛ ɔtie afotuo yɛ onyansafoɔ.
Ogyimifoɔ abohuro da adi ntɛm,
na ɔbadwemma deɛ, ɔkata aniwuo so.
Deɛ ɔka nokorɛ no ka deɛ ɛtene,
na ɔdansekurumfoɔ deɛ, ɔtwa nkontompo.
Ɛwɔ deɛ ɔworo kasa sɛ nkrantɛ nwowɔeɛ,
na onyansafoɔ tɛkyerɛma sa yadeɛ.
Nokorɛ ano tim hɔ daa,
na tɛkyerɛma torofoɔ deɛ wɔnkyɛre koraa.
Nnaadaa wɔ wɔn a wɔdwene bɔne akoma mu,
na asomdwoeɛ ho afotufoɔ nya anigyeɛ.
Mmusuo biara rento ɔteneneeni,
na amaneɛ bɛhyɛ abɔnefoɔ ma.
AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne atorɔ ano,
na wɔn a wɔdi nokorɛ sɔ n’ani.
Onipa niteɛfoɔ kora nimdeɛ,
na nkwaseafoɔ akoma pae agyimisɛm mu.
Nsiyɛfoɔ nsa bɛdi panin,
na aniha nsa bɛyi toɔ.
Onipa akoma mu awerɛhoɔ boto no,
na asɛmpa ma akoma tɔ yam.
Ɔteneneeni kyerɛ ne yɔnko kwan,
na abɔnefoɔ kwan ma wɔfom.
Onihafoɔ nsa nka ne hanam,
na nsiyɛfoɔ deɛ ɔnya onipa adeɛ a ne boɔ yɛ den.
Tenenee kwan so na nkwa wɔ,
na kwatikwan deɛ, ɛkɔ owuo mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
